from IPython.display import display

#filter for not relevant ethnicities

ethnicity = "European" #hardcoded for now, query the user for this in the future

def parse_superpopulation_dict(entry):
    """
    Converts:
        "African:33.3|East Asian:33.3|South Asian:33.3"

    Into:
        {"African": 33.3, "East Asian": 33.3, "South Asian": 33.3}
    """
    if entry is None:
        return {}

    result = {}

    for part in str(entry).split("|"):
        part = part.strip()

        if not part or ":" not in part:
            continue

        superpop, value = part.split(":", 1)

        try:
            value = float(value.strip())
        except ValueError:
            value = None

        result[superpop.strip()] = value

    return result


def filter_scores_by_ethnicity_and_best_share(data, ethnicity):
    data = data.copy()

    data["ancestry_distribution_dict"] = data[
        "ancestry_distribution_pgs_evaluation"
    ].apply(parse_superpopulation_dict)

    data["target_ethnicity_share"] = data["ancestry_distribution_dict"].apply(
        lambda d: d.get(ethnicity)
    )

    before_ethnicity_filter = len(data)

    data = data[data["target_ethnicity_share"].notna()].copy()

    after_ethnicity_filter = len(data)

    max_share_per_trait = data.groupby("reported_trait")[
        "target_ethnicity_share"
    ].transform("max")

    before_best_share_filter = len(data)

    data = data[data["target_ethnicity_share"] == max_share_per_trait].copy()

    after_best_share_filter = len(data)

    print(
        f"Dropped {before_ethnicity_filter - after_ethnicity_filter} rows "
        f"that did not include ethnicity: {ethnicity}"
    )

    print(
        f"Dropped {before_best_share_filter - after_best_share_filter} rows "
        f"that had lower {ethnicity} share within the same reported_trait"
    )

    return data.drop(columns=[
        "ancestry_distribution_dict",
        "target_ethnicity_share"
    ])

data = filter_scores_by_ethnicity_and_best_share(data, ethnicity)
data = data.drop_duplicates()

## Prepare data

```{python}
import numpy as np

data['reported_trait'] = data['reported_trait'].str.lower()



data["individual_hazard_ratio"] = (
    (data["hazard_ratio"].astype(float) ** data["z_most_similar_pop"].astype(float)) - 1
) * 100

data["individual_odds_ratio"] = (
    (data["odds_ratio"].astype(float) ** data["z_most_similar_pop"].astype(float)) - 1
) * 100


summarized_data = data.groupby("reported_trait").agg(
    mean_hazard_ratio = ("individual_hazard_ratio", "mean"),
    hazard_ratio_sd = ("individual_hazard_ratio", "std"),
    mean_odds_ratio = ("individual_odds_ratio", "mean"),
    odds_ratio_sd = ("individual_odds_ratio", "std"),
    mean_auroc = ("auroc", "mean"),
    auroc_sd = ("auroc", "std"),
    mean_percentile = ("percentile_most_similar_pop", "mean"),
    z_most_similar_pop = ("z_most_similar_pop", "mean") #calculated on a reported_trait basis
).reset_index()

display(summarized_data)

#first aggregate per specific_trait as they have a one to many relationship with the reported_trait






hazard_subset = data[data["individual_hazard_ratio"].notna()][["specific_trait", "individual_hazard_ratio", "reported_trait", "ppm_id"]]

odds_ratio_subset = data[data["individual_odds_ratio"].notna()][["specific_trait", "individual_odds_ratio", "reported_trait", "ppm_id"]]


percentile_subset = data.drop_duplicates(subset=["pgs_id"])
percentile_subset["percentile_most_similar_pop"] = percentile_subset["percentile_most_similar_pop"]-50


```

## table

```{python}

df = publications_meta_data.copy()



# Convert everything to display-friendly strings (avoids weird formatting / NaNs)
df_display = df.fillna("").astype(str)

# Align numeric-looking columns to the right, others left
def is_numeric_col(series: pd.Series) -> bool:
    s = pd.to_numeric(series.replace("", pd.NA), errors="coerce")
    return s.notna().mean() > 0.85  # mostly numeric

col_align = ["right" if is_numeric_col(df[c]) else "left" for c in df.columns]

# Zebra striping
row_colors = ["white" if i % 2 == 0 else "#F7F8FA" for i in range(len(df_display))]

fig = go.Figure(
    data=[
        go.Table(
            columnwidth=[1] * len(df_display.columns),
            header=dict(
                values=[f"<b>{c}</b>" for c in df_display.columns],
                fill_color="#F1F3F5",
                font=dict(color="#111827", size=13, family="Inter, Arial"),
                align="left",
                height=36,
                line_color="#E5E7EB",
            ),
            cells=dict(
                values=[df_display[c].tolist() for c in df_display.columns],
                fill_color=[row_colors],  # zebra stripes across rows
                font=dict(color="#111827", size=12, family="Inter, Arial"),
                align=col_align,
                height=30,
                line_color="#E5E7EB",
            ),
        )
    ]
)

fig.update_layout(
    title=dict(
        text="Publications Metadata",
        x=0,
        xanchor="left",
        font=dict(size=18, family="Inter, Arial", color="#111827"),
    ),
    paper_bgcolor="white",
    plot_bgcolor="white",
    margin=dict(l=0, r=0, t=55, b=0),
    height=min(850, 140 + 28 * (len(df_display) + 1)),  # auto-ish height
)

fig.show()
```
